title_en: Fall of the communist regime in Romania
title_ro: Căderea regimului comunist în România
description_en: Romanian Revolution of December 1989; end of the Ceausescu regime and of the closed-border policy.
source_publisher: unverified - general knowledge, no reachable official page

title_en: Swiss voters reject EEA membership
title_ro: Elvețienii resping aderarea la SEE
description_en: Federal decree on the European Economic Area rejected: 49.66% yes, turnout 78.74% (yes majority in 8 of 26 cantons, derived count).
expected_effect: Switzerland stays outside EEA; bilateral path

title_en: Agreement on the Free Movement of Persons (AFMP) signed
title_ro: Semnarea Acordului privind libera circulație a persoanelor (ALCP)
description_en: The AFMP between Switzerland and the EU was signed on 21 June 1999 (part of Bilaterals I).

title_en: Swiss vote approves Bilateral Agreements I
title_ro: Referendum: aprobarea Acordurilor bilaterale I
description_en: Sectoral agreements Switzerland-EC (incl. free movement) approved: 67.19% yes, turnout 48.31%.

title_en: AFMP enters into force (EU-15/EFTA)
title_ro: Intrarea în vigoare a ALCP (UE-15/AELS)
description_en: The AFMP has been in force since 1 June 2002; each EU enlargement was covered by an additional protocol.
expected_effect: free movement for old EU states only

title_en: Switzerland-Romania visa waiver agreement enters into force
title_ro: Intră în vigoare acordul Elveția-România de eliminare a vizelor
description_en: Agreement of 15 December 2003 between the Swiss Federal Council and the Government of Romania on the mutual abolition of the visa requirement (SR 0.142.116.632.1) entered into force on 22 February 2004.
expected_effect: visa-free short stays; no right to work

title_en: Swiss vote approves Schengen/Dublin association
title_ro: Referendum: asocierea Elveției la Schengen/Dublin
description_en: Bilateral agreements on association to Schengen and Dublin approved: 54.63% yes, turnout 56.64%.

title_en: Swiss vote extends free movement to the 10 new EU states
title_ro: Referendum: extinderea liberei circulații la cele 10 noi state UE
description_en: Extension of the AFMP to the 2004 accession states and revised accompanying measures approved: 55.98% yes, turnout 54.29%.

title_en: Protocol I (EU-10) enters into force
title_ro: Intrarea în vigoare a Protocolului I (UE-10)
description_en: Protocol I extending the AFMP to the ten 2004 accession states entered into force on 1 April 2006, with transitional restrictions for the EU-8 until 30 April 2011.

title_en: Swiss vote approves the Eastern Europe Cooperation Act
title_ro: Referendum: Legea cooperării cu statele Europei de Est
description_en: Federal Act on Cooperation with the States of Eastern Europe approved: 53.42% yes, turnout 44.98%; legal basis of the Swiss enlargement contribution.
expected_effect: basis for contribution to new EU states

title_en: Romania and Bulgaria join the European Union
title_ro: România și Bulgaria aderă la Uniunea Europeană
description_en: Romania and Bulgaria (EU-2) joined the EU on 1 January 2007 (date as given in the Observatory report tables); the AFMP did not apply to them until Protocol II.

title_en: Protocol II (Bulgaria/Romania) signed in Brussels
title_ro: Semnarea Protocolului II (Bulgaria/România) la Bruxelles
description_en: Protocol extending the AFMP to Bulgaria and Romania signed (date seen in a search snippet of an EJPD/EDA page only).

title_en: Global financial crisis and 2009 recession
title_ro: Criza financiară globală și recesiunea din 2009
description_en: Global financial crisis (Lehman Brothers collapse, September 2008) followed by recession in Switzerland and a deep recession in Romania in 2009.
expected_effect: push from Romania; weaker Swiss labour demand
source_publisher: unverified - general knowledge, no reachable official page

title_en: Switzerland becomes an operational Schengen member
title_ro: Elveția devine membru operațional Schengen
description_en: Systematic person checks at land borders with Schengen neighbours ended on 12 December 2008 (airports followed in March 2009).
source_publisher: unverified - general knowledge, no reachable official page

title_en: First Swiss enlargement contribution to Romania
title_ro: Prima contribuție elvețiană (de extindere) pentru România
description_en: Between 2009 and 2019 Switzerland financed projects in Romania with around CHF 180 million under the enlargement contribution (Federal Council wording of 12 December 2022).
expected_effect: institutional ties; no direct migration effect

title_en: Swiss registered unemployment peaks after the financial crisis
title_ro: Vârf al șomajului înregistrat în Elveția după criza financiară
description_en: Registered unemployment rate (annual average): 2.6% in 2008, 3.7% in 2009, 3.5% in 2010, 2.8% in 2011; monthly peak 4.4% in December 2009.
expected_effect: weaker labour demand at the start of Protocol II
source_publisher: SECO (Die Lage auf dem Arbeitsmarkt, January 2026, table 17)

title_en: Swiss vote: continuation of free movement and extension to Bulgaria and Romania
title_ro: Referendum: continuarea liberei circulații și extinderea la Bulgaria și România
description_en: Continuation of the AFMP and approval of Protocol II accepted: 59.61% yes, turnout 51.44% (yes majority in 22 of 26 cantons, derived count).

title_en: Protocol II enters into force: transitional regime for Romanians
title_ro: Intrarea în vigoare a Protocolului II: regim tranzitoriu pentru români
description_en: Protocol II in force since 1 June 2009. Transitional restrictions for Bulgarian/Romanian workers: quotas, priority for resident workers, prior control of wage and working conditions. Quotas 1 June 2009-31 May 2010: 362 B and 3620 L permits (EU-2 together).
source_publisher: Swiss Federal Council (admin.ch press release); quotas: 11th Observatory report, table B.3

title_en: Romanian austerity package (public wage cuts, VAT rise)
title_ro: Pachetul de austeritate din România (tăieri salariale, majorarea TVA)
description_en: Austerity measures under the EU/IMF programme took effect in mid-2010: public-sector wage cut and VAT increase (figures not verified on a reachable official page).
source_publisher: unverified - general knowledge, no reachable official page

title_en: Framework agreement on the enlargement contribution signed with Romania (unverified)
title_ro: Semnarea acordului-cadru privind contribuția de extindere cu România (neverificat)
description_en: Lead from a search snippet of an EDA page: bilateral framework agreements with Bulgaria and Romania signed in Bern; exact amount for Romania not verified (the EDA country site sits on a blocked host).
source_publisher: EDA (redirects to a blocked host; search snippet)

title_en: First extension of the restrictions for Bulgaria and Romania
title_ro: Prima prelungire a restricțiilor pentru Bulgaria și România
description_en: Switzerland extended the restrictions for Bulgarian and Romanian workers twice, in 2011 and 2014 (year verified; the 1 June 2011 start of phase 2 follows from the phase structure, the decision date was not verified). Quota 1 June 2011-31 May 2012: 684 B, 6355 L.

title_en: End of transitional restrictions for Romanians in all EU member states
title_ro: Sfârșitul restricțiilor tranzitorii pentru români în toate statele UE
description_en: From 1 January 2014 Romanian workers had unrestricted access to the labour markets of all EU states (e.g. Germany, UK), while Switzerland kept quotas.
source_publisher: unverified - general knowledge, no reachable official page

title_en: Swiss vote accepts the initiative 'Against mass immigration'
title_ro: Referendum: acceptarea inițiativei «Împotriva imigrației în masă»
description_en: Popular initiative accepted: 50.33% yes, turnout 56.57%. New Art. 121a requires annual ceilings and quotas; three years for implementation.
source_publisher: BFS (STAT-TAB px-x-1703030000_100); Federal Council statement https://www.admin.ch/de/nsb?id=51948

title_en: Safeguard clause for EU-8 and EU-17 expires
title_ro: Expiră clauza de salvgardare pentru UE-8 și UE-17
description_en: Quotas invoked in 2012 (EU-8) and June 2013 (EU-17) lapsed on 30 April and 31 May 2014; full free movement again for 25 EU states, while Romania and Bulgaria stayed under the transitional regime.
expected_effect: Romanians still restricted while others freed

title_en: Swiss voters reject a national minimum wage
title_ro: Referendum: respingerea salariului minim național
description_en: Minimum wage initiative rejected: 23.73% yes, turnout 56.36%; minimum wages remain a cantonal matter.

title_en: Final extension of the transitional period for Bulgaria and Romania
title_ro: Ultima prelungire a perioadei tranzitorii pentru Bulgaria și România
description_en: Federal Council extends priority for residents, quotas and wage controls from 1 June 2014 to 31 May 2016. End 2013: 15199 Bulgarian and Romanian long-term residents (+18.1% in 2013; 0.8% of the EU/EFTA resident population); B quotas fully used in recent years.

title_en: Romanian presidential election: queues at diaspora polling stations
title_ro: Alegerile prezidențiale din România: cozi la secțiile din diaspora
description_en: Two rounds (2 and 16 November 2014); many voters abroad could not vote because of long queues, a politically mobilising episode for the diaspora.
source_publisher: unverified - general knowledge, no reachable official page

title_en: Swiss voters reject the Ecopop initiative
title_ro: Referendum: respingerea inițiativei Ecopop
description_en: Initiative 'Stop overpopulation' (cap on net immigration) rejected: 25.90% yes, turnout 49.98%.

title_en: Unemployment rises after the franc shock
title_ro: Șomajul crește după șocul francului
description_en: Registered unemployment rate (annual average): 3.0% in 2014, 3.2% in 2015, 3.3% in 2016, 3.1% in 2017, 2.5% in 2018.
source_publisher: SECO (Die Lage auf dem Arbeitsmarkt, January 2026, table 17)

title_en: Swiss National Bank removes the EUR/CHF minimum exchange rate
title_ro: Banca Națională a Elveției renunță la cursul minim EUR/CHF
description_en: The SNB discontinued the minimum exchange rate against the euro; the franc appreciated sharply (official SNB page not reachable).
expected_effect: raises CHF wages in EUR/RON terms; slows hiring
source_publisher: unverified - general knowledge, no reachable official page

title_en: End of the transitional regime: full free movement for Romanians (first time)
title_ro: Sfârșitul regimului tranzitoriu: liberă circulație deplină pentru români (prima dată)
description_en: Transitional period ended 31 May 2016 (ordinance adopted 13 April 2016). End 2015: 18364 Bulgarian and Romanian permanent residents (0.9% of the foreign resident population); 1542 workers admitted for long-term stay in 2015 (-22.1%). Safeguard clause possible until 31 May 2019 if immigration exceeds the 3-year mean by 10%.
expected_effect: removes quotas, priority rule, wage pre-check

title_en: Parliament adopts the implementing law for Art. 121a (preference for job-seekers)
title_ro: Parlamentul adoptă legea de aplicare a art. 121a (prioritate pentru șomeri)
description_en: Parliament's decision of 16 December 2016 implements the immigration article in a way compatible with the AFMP (job-seeker preference instead of quotas).
expected_effect: no general quotas for EU nationals

title_en: Safeguard clause for Romania and Bulgaria: B permits capped
title_ro: Clauza de salvgardare pentru România și Bulgaria: permise B plafonate
description_en: Federal Council decision of 10 May 2017: for 12 months from 1 June 2017 B permits for EU-2 workers limited to 996 units, released quarterly; conditions for L permits not met (no L quota).
expected_effect: caps B permits; shifts to L permits

title_en: Cantonal minimum wage introduced in Neuchâtel (unverified)
title_ro: Introducerea salariului minim cantonal în Neuchâtel (neverificat)
description_en: One of the five cantons (NE, JU, GE, TI, BS) with a statutory cantonal minimum wage; date and hourly amount not verified on a reachable official page.
source_publisher: unverified - general knowledge, no reachable official page

title_en: Cantonal minimum wage introduced in Jura (unverified)
title_ro: Introducerea salariului minim cantonal în Jura (neverificat)
description_en: One of the five cantons (NE, JU, GE, TI, BS) with a statutory cantonal minimum wage; date and hourly amount not verified on a reachable official page.
source_publisher: unverified - general knowledge, no reachable official page

title_en: Romania raises public health-sector wages
title_ro: România majorează salariile din sănătatea publică
description_en: Pay rise for doctors and nurses in public hospitals, meant to slow the emigration of health workers that followed EU accession and the 2010 wage cuts (not verified on a reachable official page).
source_publisher: unverified - general knowledge, no reachable official page

title_en: Safeguard clause extended for one more year
title_ro: Prelungirea clauzei de salvgardare cu încă un an
description_en: Decision in principle 18 April 2018, ordinance 16 May 2018: B permits for EU-2 workers and self-employed stay limited to 996 units from 1 June 2018; L threshold not reached.

title_en: Job-vacancy notification duty enters into force
title_ro: Intră în vigoare obligația de anunțare a locurilor de muncă vacante
description_en: Vacancies in occupations with unemployment above 8% must first be notified to the public employment service from 1 July 2018; threshold lowered to 5% on 1 January 2020.

title_en: Diaspora protest in Bucharest
title_ro: Protestul diasporei de la București
description_en: Large anti-government rally organised by Romanians living abroad in Victoriei Square, dispersed by the gendarmerie.
source_publisher: unverified - general knowledge, no reachable official page

title_en: European elections and justice referendum: queues abroad again
title_ro: Alegeri europarlamentare și referendum: din nou cozi în diaspora
description_en: Long queues at polling stations abroad; followed by a reform (three voting days abroad, postal voting) applied at the November 2019 presidential election.
source_publisher: unverified - general knowledge, no reachable official page

title_en: Unrestricted free movement for Romanians and Bulgarians
title_ro: Liberă circulație fără restricții pentru români și bulgari
description_en: Safeguard clause expired on 31 May 2019 (ordinance amended 15 May 2019); from 1 June 2019 EU-2 nationals have full free movement on the same terms as other EU citizens. Protocol II allowed a transition of at most ten years.

title_en: COVID-19 unemployment peak, then tight labour market
title_ro: Vârful șomajului din pandemie, apoi piață a muncii tensionată
description_en: Registered unemployment rate (annual average): 2.3% in 2019, 3.2% in 2020, 3.0% in 2021, 2.2% in 2022, 2.0% in 2023, 2.4% in 2024, 2.8% in 2025; monthly peak 3.7% in January-February 2021.
expected_effect: temporary dip, then strong labour demand 2022-2023
source_publisher: SECO (Die Lage auf dem Arbeitsmarkt, January 2026, table 17)

title_en: COVID-19: Swiss entry restrictions introduced step by step
title_ro: COVID-19: restricții de intrare în Elveția introduse treptat
description_en: The Federal Council introduced entry restrictions step by step from 13 March 2020; until 15 June entry from most EU/EFTA states was allowed only in exceptional cases (restrictions with Germany and Austria eased on 16 May 2020).

title_en: COVID-19: entry restrictions extended to all Schengen states
title_ro: COVID-19: restricțiile de intrare extinse la toate statele Schengen
description_en: On 25 March 2020 the Federal Council was informed that the entry restrictions had been extended to all Schengen states.

title_en: COVID-19: full free movement with EU/EFTA restored
title_ro: COVID-19: restabilirea liberei circulații cu UE/AELS
description_en: Entry restrictions towards all Schengen states lifted on 15 June 2020; full free movement again with all EU/EFTA states and the UK. Romania (non-Schengen) stayed on the risk list for third-country nationals, but persons with free-movement rights could enter.

title_en: Swiss voters reject the limitation initiative
title_ro: Referendum: respingerea inițiativei de limitare
description_en: Initiative 'For moderate immigration' (termination of the AFMP) rejected: 38.29% yes, turnout 59.49% (yes majority in 4 of 26 cantons, derived count).

title_en: Cantonal minimum wage introduced in Geneva (unverified)
title_ro: Introducerea salariului minim cantonal în Geneva (neverificat)
description_en: One of the five cantons (NE, JU, GE, TI, BS) with a statutory cantonal minimum wage; date and hourly amount not verified on a reachable official page.
source_publisher: unverified - general knowledge, no reachable official page

title_en: Cantonal minimum wage introduced in Ticino (unverified)
title_ro: Introducerea salariului minim cantonal în Ticino (neverificat)
description_en: One of the five cantons (NE, JU, GE, TI, BS) with a statutory cantonal minimum wage; date and hourly amount not verified on a reachable official page.
source_publisher: unverified - general knowledge, no reachable official page

title_en: Federal Council ends talks on the institutional framework agreement
title_ro: Consiliul Federal încheie negocierile privind acordul-cadru instituțional
description_en: Switzerland terminated the negotiations with the EU on an institutional agreement; starting point of the later package approach (Bilaterals III).
source_publisher: unverified - general knowledge, no reachable official page

title_en: Swiss vote approves the Frontex regulation (Schengen)
title_ro: Referendum: aprobarea regulamentului Frontex (Schengen)
description_en: Adoption of the EU Border and Coast Guard regulation approved: 71.48% yes, turnout 39.98%; Schengen association maintained.

title_en: Cantonal minimum wage introduced in Basel-Stadt (unverified)
title_ro: Introducerea salariului minim cantonal în Basel-Stadt (neverificat)
description_en: One of the five cantons (NE, JU, GE, TI, BS) with a statutory cantonal minimum wage; date and hourly amount not verified on a reachable official page.
source_publisher: unverified - general knowledge, no reachable official page

title_en: Second Swiss contribution: framework agreement with Romania signed
title_ro: A doua contribuție elvețiană: semnarea acordului-cadru cu România
description_en: Signed in Bucharest by President Cassis and Finance Minister Caciu: Switzerland provides CHF 221.5 million for projects in Romania until 2029 (second-largest allocation of the cohesion part).
source_publisher: Swiss Federal Council (admin.ch press release); EDA https://www.eda.admin.ch/en/bilateral-relations-switzerland-romania

title_en: Romania joins Schengen for air and sea borders
title_ro: România intră în Schengen cu frontierele aeriene și maritime
description_en: The EU Council decided unanimously at the end of 2023 to lift person checks at internal air and sea borders with Bulgaria and Romania as of 31 March 2024.
expected_effect: easier air travel; residence rights unchanged

title_en: Romanian presidential election annulled and re-run
title_ro: Alegerile prezidențiale din România: anulare și reluare
description_en: First round 24 November 2024 annulled by the Constitutional Court in December 2024; re-run in May 2025 (4 and 18 May) with a high diaspora turnout.
source_publisher: unverified - general knowledge, no reachable official page

title_en: Switzerland-EU negotiations on the new package concluded in substance (unverified date)
title_ro: Încheierea de fond a negocierilor Elveția-UE pentru noul pachet (dată neverificată)
description_en: Lead: material conclusion of the negotiations on the package (Bilaterals III), followed by initialling and a public consultation in 2025; exact dates not verified on a reachable page.
expected_effect: prepares updated AFMP with safeguard clause
source_publisher: unverified - general knowledge, no reachable official page

title_en: Romania becomes a full Schengen member (land borders)
title_ro: România devine membru Schengen deplin (frontiere terestre)
description_en: Internal land border controls with Romania and Bulgaria lifted as of 1 January 2025; the Federal Council approved the corresponding exchange of notes on 20 December 2024 (no direct effect for Switzerland).

title_en: Second Swiss contribution: five programme agreements signed
title_ro: A doua contribuție elvețiană: semnarea a cinci acorduri de program
description_en: Five agreements for the implementation programmes of the second contribution were signed on 20 February 2025 (visit of Federal Councillor Cassis to Bucharest).

title_en: Switzerland-EU package (Bilaterals III) signed in Brussels
title_ro: Semnarea pachetului Elveția-UE (Bilaterale III) la Bruxelles
description_en: President Guy Parmelin and Commission President Ursula von der Leyen signed the agreements of the Switzerland-EU package on 2 March 2026.

title_en: Federal Council sends the Bilaterals III dispatch to Parliament (new safeguard clause)
title_ro: Consiliul Federal trimite Parlamentului mesajul privind Bilateralele III (nouă clauză de salvgardare)
description_en: Dispatch adopted 13 March 2026 (36 federal acts amended): free movement stays labour-market oriented and a new safeguard clause lets Switzerland act on its own if EU immigration causes serious problems. Optional referendum proposed (confirmed 12 August 2026); package under parliamentary debate at access date, not in force.
expected_effect: possible future limits on EU immigration
source_publisher: Swiss Federal Council (admin.ch press release); https://www.admin.ch/de/paket-schweiz-eu

title_en: Swiss voters reject the 'No to a 10-million Switzerland' initiative
title_ro: Referendum: respingerea inițiativei «Nu unei Elveții de 10 milioane»
description_en: Sustainability initiative rejected by the people: 45.21% yes, turnout 58.86% (yes majority in 12 of 26 cantons, derived count; BFS table last updated 2026-08-21).
expected_effect: no population cap; AFMP not terminated
